cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You first. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say 'hello' without asking about the gas bill?

mechanism: A professionally controls the order and specificity of reciprocal admissions so B acknowledges longing before A reveals it.
confusable: D80 asks a risky disclosure as trust proof; D88 specifically withholds A attachment until B admits it first.
comparison: Chair alternative tests a practical resale explanation before confession; flat alternative sets a direct you-first sequence and concrete evening cue.
seedUse: Returned flat, quiet, key hope, every evening and landline voice derive from D88-a; S03 adds exact question/answer sequencing.
